not_applicable.reason: fast-jwt's JWKS support (get-jwks) is async only
get-jwks converts JWKs with jwk-to-pem, which doesn't support OKP (Ed25519) keys

notes: JWKS document: a verifier per key, made once, picked by the token's `kid` (read with `createDecoder`)

JWKS URL rows are fast-jwt + get-jwks 11.0.3 (fast-jwt's documented integration), so they time both: on every verify get-jwks converts the cached JWK to a PEM (with jwk-to-pem) and fast-jwt imports that PEM (`createPublicKey`), which is why they're slow
